payload.build_machine:
THE CHUNK SET, seeded now because only now is it known what will be built. Small, resumable, dependency edges as relations, iteration-unique ids, one realization kind each.

AN HONEST NOTE ON ORDERING, first, because it changes how this state should be read: most of these chunks are ALREADY COMPLETE. The owner ordered the round injection built before the rewalk began, and the engine promotion followed from the same instruction. So this is not a plan for work to come — it is the build machine drawn over work whose sequence was set by a ruling. I record the dependencies as they actually bound, not as a schedule I invented afterwards.

C1 THE ROUND INJECTION — realization: engine. DONE, promoted.
  Appends the four rounds to every gate's evidence form where forms are built. Depends on nothing. Everything the rewalk found depends on IT.
  Resumability: single-point change, one function. Its blast radius was eight fixture-gate tests, which is the evidence that it binds.

C2 REOPEN — realization: engine. DONE, promoted, twice repaired.
  Depends on C1: reopen exists to carry out a verdict that C1 makes collectable. Building it first would have been a mechanism with nothing to trigger it.
  Resumability: this chunk is the argument for small chunks. It shipped, deadlocked the live walk, was fixed, deadlocked differently, was fixed again. Each repair was a separate promotable unit with its own red-observed test.

C3 SEARCH, TWO PROVIDERS — realization: engine. DONE, promoted.
  Working-tree searcher and ref searcher under one result contract; context in the same call; bounds and containment.
  Depends on nothing in this set; parallel with C1 and C2 in principle.

C4 READ, GLOB, BATCH PATCH — realization: engine. DONE, promoted.
  Range reads with oversize refusal, glob, atomic batch patching. Independent of C3 in code, adjacent in purpose.

C5 GUARDS AND REFUSALS — realization: engine. DONE, promoted.
  Required-argument enforcement including the absent-versus-empty distinction, ambiguous-root refusal, refusals that name the fact.
  Depends on C3 and C4 — it constrains their entry points.

C6 LINT REGISTRY — realization: engine. DONE, promoted.
  Every check yields pass, fail or defer-with-reason; a deferral carries its reason.

C7 CONFIG LANE — realization: engine. DONE, promoted. Machine-local settings, secrets masked.

C8 RECORD DURABILITY — realization: engine. DONE, promoted. Annotated tags, commit hash in the grant, branch deleted after merge, push configuration.

C9 ENGINE PROMOTION — realization: engine. DONE, promoted, and the chunk with the most repairs after C2.
  Depends on C1 in spirit: promotion exists so the shared judge is the same for every agent, and what makes the judge worth sharing is that it collects the review.
  Five distinct diagnosis failures, each a separate fix: install ordering, the runner's directory argument, the inherited test context, the commit-message path, the inherited session admission.

C10 THE CONSOLE-WINDOW SWEEP — realization: engine plus lint. DONE, promoted.
  Sixteen call sites plus a source-class check. Unplanned, from live use.

C11 FITNESS PROPERTIES — realization: test. DONE, promoted (dda426e).
  Depends on C1 and C2 — it asserts properties OF them. Could not have been written first, which is why it is a promoted spike output rather than an original chunk.

C12 THE APPLICABILITY JOIN — realization: engine. NOT STARTED, AND BLOCKED.
  Depends on a decision that does not exist: the selector vocabulary. Its spike did not run. This chunk is drawn so the gap is visible in the build machine rather than absent from it — an undrawn chunk reads as work nobody wanted.
  What unblocks it: the applicability spike, with a hand-written answer key produced BEFORE any selection is run.

PARALLELISM, as it actually was: C3, C4, C7, C8 are mutually independent and could have fanned out. C1 → C2 → C11 is a genuine chain. C5 depends on C3 and C4. C9 stands alone but had to be built before anything else could reach the running lane, which is why it was built early despite being late in this list.

WHAT THE CHUNKING BOUGHT, measured rather than asserted: this iteration was interrupted repeatedly — by two engine deadlocks, five promotion refusals, a reconnect, and four owner interventions that each changed something. Not one of those lost work, because every unit was small enough to finish, verify and promote on its own. A monolithic build would have been unwound by the first deadlock.
payload.promotions_placed:
THREE PROMOTED SPIKE OUTPUTS, each placed with its dependency rather than appended.

P1 THE BINARY-EXCLUSION TEST → placed in C11, depending on C3 (search, two providers).
  From the parser-edges spike. It pins a flag that today looks like a tidy default with no reason attached. Placed as a TEST rather than a comment because a comment is the weakest guard and the next person simplifying that argument list will not read it — they will read the suite going red.

P2 THE REOPEN PROPERTY → placed in C11, depending on C2.
  From the spike that did NOT run at M6. It entered the build anyway, which is legal — the spike is downstream of the whole process — and it is the only check in the set that would have caught defects we did not already have. Verified against that claim rather than assuming it: both fixes were disabled in turn and it failed each time, naming the right failure.

P3 THE GATE-ROUNDS PROPERTY → placed in C11, depending on C1.
  From the M5 fitness candidates. A property over every gate in the machine, guarding the iteration's central claim against the exact way that claim was broken before: a gate authored later, differently, that quietly omits them.

NOT PLACED, and the omission is the point: nothing from the applicability spike, because it did not run. C12 is drawn as blocked rather than seeded with a guessed selector. A wrong selector is worse than a missing one, because it looks like coverage — and this iteration exists because a rule that looked like coverage went unfilled for the project's entire history.
